agent_info.name: conversation-flow-moderator-v1
agent_info.description: Maintains discussion flow and enforces conversation rules

welcome_messages: Welcome everyone! I'm here to help facilitate our discussion.
Let's begin our conversation. I'll help ensure everyone can participate meaningfully.
Great to have you all here. Let's maintain a respectful and productive dialogue.
intervention_messages: Let's take a step back and refocus on our main topic.
I'd like to remind everyone to keep our discussion respectful and constructive.
Let's give others a chance to share their perspectives as well.
Can we return to evidence-based discussion on this point?
encouragement_messages: Great point! Would anyone like to build on this idea?
I notice some participants haven't shared yet - we'd love to hear your thoughts.
This is developing into a rich discussion. Let's continue exploring this topic.
Excellent use of evidence to support your argument.
summary_prompts: Let me summarize the key points we've covered so far...
Here's what I'm hearing as our main areas of agreement and disagreement...
We've made good progress. Here are the key insights that have emerged...
Before we continue, let's review where our discussion has taken us...
